target: the Sol model id is overridable from ./.env and resolved AFTER load_env — reading it earlier silently ignores every override, the exact ordering bug found in doctor.sh during spec 019
cmd: printf "OPENROUTER_MODEL_SOL=openai/gpt-5.6-sol\n" > .env; D="$PWD/req.json"; cat "$FIXTURES/sol-transport/brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openrouter-with-cost.json" SOL_REQUEST_DUMP="$D" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter >/dev/null 2>&1; M=$(jq -r .model "$D"); echo "resolved=$M"; [ "$M" = "openai/gpt-5.6-sol" ] && echo OVERRIDE_HONOURED
